resolvedAttempts.name: focused-edge
command: --test-name-pattern=^Lionel grants every|^Lionel does not consume|^Neme optional shield replacement|^Owen simultaneous

reason: Complete Neme first-shield-break replacement; latest Lionel summoned entry/first opposing creature break Light shield triggers; Owen summoned grave recycle/three shields and allied shield-two leave replacement. Explicit user priority: Fly King Chris Tabula Rasa, complete Zenith revolution change/world break/both-hand face-down mana/live spell lock/Eternal Kappa.
validationNotes: Baseline 1baf71d7 and start nameKey 9329 inspected. Three researched shield cards plus the explicitly requested Fly King form one four-card batch; real nameKey count 9333. Existing IDs, original 9329 definitions, catalogue, image references and save formats preserved.

All full official abilities, stats, printed mana, restrictions and seven original/reprint images reviewed. Latest Lionel/Owen wording used. The Lionel reprint still says break-shita-toki (after breaking); an earlier draft reading of suru-toki was corrected before final validation. Same-name reprints add no names. Original Chris Tabula Rasa is a different card and was not added.

Neme: Blocker/T, one chosen first shield of a simultaneous break is retained while a new top shield is added; exact QA31560 triple-break/two-shield setup reproduced in both seats. Multiple copies, decline, new entry, next native turn, ability suppression, encrypted pending choice and active/non-active replacement priority versus burn verified.

Lionel: optional all-three draw followed independently by zero-to-three hand shields only on a real summon; other Command Dragon summons do not retrigger. First opposing creature break grants Light cards their shield triggers before declaration. Simultaneous multi-shield Light/non-Light, prior spell break, replaced burn, late source entry and native shield-trigger execution verified.

Owen: mandatory own grave recycle/shuffle precedes an optional simultaneous three-shield addition on summon; ordinary deployment does not trigger it. Native two-shield allied leave replacement covers itself, destruction/bounce/mana, no-ST return, decline, suppression and physical reservation in simultaneous destruction. QA44591 is tested as a self-return movement analogue; the unregistered physical-hand joke card Egoist is not claimed as exact reproduction.

Fly King: Zenith revolution change, no paid mana, world break of all five shields, and both complete hands (including the returned Zenith attacker) move to untapped face-down mana. Live spell lock counts its controller face-down mana with strict inequality, including twin spell faces and free shield triggers, and deactivates under ignored/sealed sources. Eternal Kappa selects exactly three own face-down cards, preserves taps/UIDs, respects simultaneous reservation, and does not replace game loss.

Exact official QA45513 reproduced in both seats with actual Beethoven and Fly King: selecting Kappa fails the exchange, leaves both creatures in their original zones, preserves all four face-down mana and tap states, and Beethoven continues its four-shield attack. The native Kappa payment is now committed only after exchange-failure checks. Both pending choices and private face-down mana survive encrypted online storage.

82 focused tests across split selections and 598 affected regressions passed, total 680. Two legal forty-card seeded games preserve all physical IDs and JSON legal actions through completion. Final check/audit/target9500/invariants pass. Official verifier refresh had reset image proof fields; reviewed image hashes were restored and target9500 passed afterward.

A broad Viride group containing 8 random-action games, a 62-game worker run and 31 replayed AI games timed out at 570.014 seconds. A negative selection unintentionally matched the file parent and was stopped after 118.618 seconds; it is not counted as passing. All 36 short unit cases were then verified using explicit positive names (6 + 30); the three long cases remain pending and are not rerun. The related-entry-leave command includes a nonexistent historical viride-rules path silently ignored by node; its 106 passes cover standard997/545, and actual Viride units are separately verified.

Historical whole npm test remains interrupted/unconfirmed. Previous individual, long and reprint deferrals preserved; this broad long group is added to pending history. No push/publication/Netlify update.
